name: GA-08
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Austin Scott seeking re-election with large financial edge
Democratic challenger Kelly Esti has raised only ~$19K with minimal cash
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~95%
model.rationale: Austin Scott holds a heavily Republican district, has a massive fundraising advantage, and faces a barely funded challenger; markets price a Republican win near certainty. The fundamentals baseline of roughly R+17 fits comfortably.
model.watch: Any late independent spending or polling showing the challenger competitive would be the only signal worth monitoring, though none is currently present.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Georgia's 8th District is a solidly Republican seat, with a partisan lean of about R+15. Incumbent Austin Scott is running for re-election and has raised over $1.1 million with $1.3 million on hand. His Democratic challenger, Kelly Esti, has raised under $20,000 and reports less than $2,000 in cash, leaving her little capacity to compete.

No independent polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put the Republican's chances around 95%. With the incumbent well positioned in a favorable district and the challenger essentially unfunded, the seat is rated Safe Republican.
